purpose: Descriptive pilot interpretation only; never select checkpoints or change reward/budget based on final test
caveat: 1 percent is an engineering description scale, NOT statistical significance; always disclose signed effect sizes and per-task results
nominal_tradeoff: Report final-checkpoint nominal validation separately; no post-test retuning
portfolio_rule: If strong-integral extra benefit is absent or tiny/inconsistent across seeds, recommend ending algorithm expansion and packaging honest negative/positive results
